CodeMirror 6.0.2 with @codemirror/lang-json 6.0.2 provides JSON syntax highlighting
and syntax diagnostics. The bundled editor lives in amd/build/menu_json_editor.min.js;
its source is editor-src/menu-json-editor.js. The source map includes the exact
runtime source. The adjacent files preserve the MIT notices of the bundled libraries.

Project and API: https://codemirror.net/ and
https://code.haverbeke.berlin/codemirror/lang-json.
